title: Bill Invoices To sits after Credit Limit and before Sales Representative
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a build where New Customer and Edit Customer show the Credit Terms and Credit Limit fields beside each other and a Sales Representative field (they come from the Credit Terms and Split Representatives work).
  • Start on the Customers page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Bill Invoices To" sits on the line after Credit Terms and Credit Limit.
  • "Sales Representative" comes right after "Bill Invoices To".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12304 (Story 2, Bill Invoices To in New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S2-R2: “The field sits after Credit Terms | Credit Limit and before Sales Representative (context: field order shared with SV-11638 and SV-10890).”
  • Out of Scope: “Credit Terms (SV-11638) and Split Representatives (SV-10890). Their own PRDs own their fields and behavior. This PRD only notes where a Bill To screen depends on them.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: pictures "Bill Invoices To, empty" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", This build), "Saved default" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p1-02-after-bill-invoices-to-empty.png
  • bt-p1-07-after-saved-default.png

The design's own words:

  • “"Bill Invoices To" sits after Credit Terms and Credit Limit and before Sales Representative. It reads "This customer".”
  • “"Bill Invoices To" shows the saved default, "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair".”
